evidence.reason: vm-feasibility builds QEMU `-drive` options by interpolating the resolved run path directly. QEMU treats commas inside option values as delimiters and requires embedded commas to be doubled; the code has no escaping or comma validation, so a run directory such as `probe,local` produces malformed `file=...` arguments and QEMU cannot open the overlay or seed. This is an ordinary implementation bug in the existing command construction, not a new requirement.
